findings: The same canonical URL's 2026-11-07 capture is only a 15-line variant index: iOS, Android, and React Native links at new raw:13-15. It provides no platform-specific Appearance API properties, code, defaults, version, dark-mode behavior, font names, or precedence rules. The collection diff removes the old 242-line compiled guide because the current unqualified rendering routes to variants; this is a content-routing change, not evidence that the feature or any platform API was deprecated.

The matched old 2026-04-22 raw contains distinct platform sections: iOS 8-70 with PaymentSheet.Configuration appearance and UIFont; Android 72-161 with PaymentSheet.Appearance colors/typography/shapes and colorsDark; React Native 163-242 with initPaymentSheet appearance, font family/scale, and primary-button overrides. Current source 13-77 summarizes and excerpts this older substantive evidence and links screenshots. Preserve that provenance as dated.

Current source wiki/sources/source-stripe-inapp-appearance-api.md:13 says all three platforms share a conceptual customization structure while using platform-specific APIs. The new index supports only that three variants exist, not the older detailed behavior or current compatibility of the code snippets. It should remain navigation to the variant URLs and not become a factual raw_files entry for those claims.

The current concept wiki/concepts/stripe-inapp-payments.md:93 and Stripe index:106 route to this source for platform-specific font, color, shape, primary-button and dark-mode details. Those routes are still useful as dated historical descriptions; they should not silently cite the 15-line index as current technical verification.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the 2026-04-22 old raw and source's iOS, Android, and React Native details as a dated snapshot, including platform-specific property names and the component-over-global precedence (old raw:68,159,240). The new index omits those details without revoking them.
Retain the old platform-specific dark mode and font-name qualifications (old raw:57,126-147,211-229); the new index does not verify their present SDK behavior.
Treat old code blocks and images as historical examples rather than proven runnable code or a guarantee of present SDK/API compatibility.
conflicts: There is an evidence-granularity conflict if current source 13-77 or concept wiki/concepts/stripe-inapp-payments.md:93 is read as grounded by the new unqualified index. Attribute those API claims to the old 2026-04-22 platform sections and mark them dated; use new raw:11-15 only as navigation to separate platform variants.

The old React Native captured example at raw:203-205 appears malformed (`...appearance: customAppearance`), while the current source at line 72 presents `initPaymentSheet({ appearance: customAppearance })`. Neither this index nor the old captured snippet validates executable current React Native syntax, so avoid treating source code as a verified runtime recipe.
unresolved_questions: The three linked 2026-11-07 variant pages were not part of this pinned comparison; current platform property names, defaults, feature parity, and SDK-version requirements remain unverified.
The variant index does not establish whether any old behavior changed, nor whether any platform's code snippet executes successfully today.
